title: एकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bhishma himself advances to fight Arjuna, and their duel with mighty divine weapons is so terrible that the onlookers say such a contest is beyond men. At last Arjuna strikes Bhishma senseless, and his charioteer, remembering his duty, carries him from the field.
summary.kn: ಭೀಷ್ಮನೇ ಅರ್ಜುನನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಲು ಮುನ್ನುಗ್ಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಮಹಾ ದಿವ್ಯಾಸ್ತ್ರಗಳ ಅವರ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಯುದ್ಧ ಎಷ್ಟು ಭೀಕರವೆಂದರೆ ಇದು ಮನುಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಮೀರಿದ್ದು ಎಂದು ನೋಡುಗರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಭೀಷ್ಮನನ್ನು ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆತಪ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಸಾರಥಿ ತನ್ನ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ನೆನೆದು ಅವನನ್ನು ರಣದಿಂದ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: स्वयं भीष्म अर्जुन से लड़ने आगे बढ़ते हैं, और महान दिव्यास्त्रों से उनका द्वन्द्व इतना भयंकर होता है कि दर्शक कहते हैं ऐसा युद्ध मनुष्यों की सामर्थ्य से परे है। अन्त में अर्जुन भीष्म को मूर्च्छित कर देते हैं, और उनका सारथि अपना कर्तव्य याद कर उन्हें रणभूमि से ले जाता है।
summary.te: భీష్ముడే అర్జునునితో పోరాడడానికి ముందుకు వస్తాడు; మహా దివ్యాస్త్రాలతో వారి ద్వంద్వయుద్ధం ఎంత భయంకరమంటే ఇది మనుషులకు మించినదని చూపరులు అంటారు. చివరకు అర్జునుడు భీష్ముని మూర్ఛపోయేలా చేస్తాడు, సారథి తన కర్తవ్యం గుర్తుచేసుకొని అతనిని రణం నుండి తీసుకువెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: பீஷ்மரே அர்ஜுனனுடன் போரிட முன்னேற, பெரும் தெய்வீக அஸ்திரங்களுடனான அவர்கள் தனிப்போர் மனிதருக்கு அப்பாற்பட்டது என்று பார்ப்போர் சொல்லும் அளவுக்குக் கொடியதாக இருக்கிறது. இறுதியில் அர்ஜுனன் பீஷ்மரை மயங்கச் செய்ய, அவர் தேரோட்டி தன் கடமையை நினைத்து அவரைக் களத்திலிருந்து கொண்டு செல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: അർജുനനോട് പൊരുതാൻ ഭീഷ്മർ തന്നെ മുന്നോട്ടുവരുന്നു; ഇരുവരുടെയും മഹത്തായ ദിവ്യാസ്ത്രയുദ്ധം അത്ര ഭയങ്കരമാണ്, അത്തരമൊരു പോരാട്ടം മനുഷ്യർക്ക് അസാധ്യമെന്ന് കാണികൾ പറയുന്നു. ഒടുവിൽ അർജുനൻ ഭീഷ്മരെ ബോധരഹിതനാക്കുന്നു; കടമ ഓർത്ത സാരഥി അദ്ദേഹത്തെ രണഭൂമിയിൽനിന്ന് കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 4.59; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Dec  1 2011

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः शांतनवो भीष्मो दुराधर्षः प्रतापवान् ।
वध्यमानेषु योधेषु धनंजयमुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhishma, son of Shantanu, formidable and glorious, saw the warriors being cut down and rushed at Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
प्रगृह्य कार्मुकश्रेष्ठं जातरूपपरिष्कृतम् ।
शरानादाय तीक्ष्णाग्रान्मर्मभेदप्रमाथिनः ॥

meaning.en: He took up a splendid bow adorned with gold, and arrows with sharp points that pierce vital spots and crush foes.

verses.text:
पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि ।
शुशुभे स नरव्याघ्रो गिरिः सूर्योदये यथा ॥

meaning.en: With a white parasol held over his head, that tiger among men shone like a mountain at sunrise.

verses.text:
प्रध्माय शङ्खं गाङ्गेयो धार्तराष्ट्रान्प्रहर्षयन् ।
प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य बीभत्सुं समवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Blowing his conch to cheer the sons of Dhritarashtra, the son of Ganga circled to the right and blocked Bibhatsu.

verses.text:
तमुद्वीक्ष्य तथायान्तं कौन्तेयः परवीरहा ।
प्रत्यगृह्णात्प्रहृष्टात्मा धाराधरमिवाचलः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him come, Arjuna, son of Kunti and slayer of enemy heroes, gladly met him, like a mountain facing a rain cloud.

verses.text:
ततो भीष्मः शरानष्टौ ध्वजे पार्थस्य वीर्यवान् ।
समपर्यन्महावेगाञ्श्वसमानानिवोरगान् ॥

meaning.en: Then mighty Bhishma planted eight arrows in the banner of Partha, arrows that rushed along hissing like snakes.

verses.text:
ते ध्वजं पाण्डुपुत्रस्य समासाद्य पतत्रिणः ।
ज्वलन्तः कपिमाजघ्नुर्ध्वजाग्रनिलयांश्च तान् ॥

meaning.en: Those blazing shafts reached the Pandava's banner and struck the ape on it and the beings dwelling on its tip.

verses.text:
ततो भल्लेन महता पृथुधारेण पाण्डवः ।
छत्रं चिच्छेद भीष्मस्य तूर्णं तदपतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandava swiftly cut down Bhishma's parasol with a large broad-edged arrow, and it fell to the ground.

verses.text:
ध्वजं चैवास्य कौन्तेयः शरैरभ्यहनद्दृढम् ।
शीघ्रकृद्रथवाहांश्च तथोभौ पार्ष्णिसारथी ॥

meaning.en: Kunti's son also pounded Bhishma's banner with arrows, and struck his swift horses and both his rear charioteers.

verses.text:
तयोस्तदभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् ।
भीष्मस्य सह पार्थेन बलिवासवयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous, hair-raising duel followed between Bhishma and Partha, like that of Bali and Indra.

verses.text:
भल्लैर्भल्लाः समागम्य भीष्मपाण्डवयोर्युधि ।
अन्तरिक्षे व्यराजन्त खद्योताः प्रावृषीव हि ॥

meaning.en: Where arrow-heads clashed with arrow-heads in the fight between Bhishma and the Pandava, they glittered in the sky like fireflies in the rains.

verses.text:
अग्निचक्रमिवाविद्धं सव्यदक्षिणमस्यतः ।
गाण्डीवमभवद्राजन्पार्थस्य सृजतः शरान् ॥

meaning.en: As Partha loosed his arrows with left and right hand, O king, the Gandiva looked like a whirling wheel of fire.

verses.text:
स तैः संछादयामास भीष्मं शरशतैः शितैः ।
पर्वतं वारिधाराभिश्छादयन्निव तोयदः ॥

meaning.en: With hundreds of sharp arrows he covered Bhishma, as a cloud covers a mountain with streams of rain.

verses.text:
तां स वेलामिवोद्धूतां शरवृष्टिं समुत्थिताम् ।
व्यधमत्सायकैर्भीष्मो अर्जुनं संनिवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma shattered that rising downpour of arrows, surging like a tide, with his own shafts and held Arjuna back.

verses.text:
ततस्तानि निकृत्तानि शरजालानि भागशः ।
समरेऽभिव्यशीर्यन्त फल्गुनस्य रथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then those nets of arrows, cut to pieces, fell scattered in the battle toward Phalguna's chariot.

verses.text:
ततः कनकपुङ्खानां शरवृष्टिं समुत्थिताम् ।
पाण्डवस्य रथात्तूर्णं शलभानामिवायतिम् ।
व्यधमत्तां पुनस्तस्य भीष्मः शरशतैः शितैः ॥

meaning.en: When the Pandava's storm of gold-feathered arrows rose from his chariot, swift like a swarm of locusts, Bhishma again scattered it with hundreds of sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ततस्ते कुरवः सर्वे साधु साध्विति चाब्रुवन् ।
दुष्करं कृतवान्भीष्मो यदर्जुनमयोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then all the Kurus cried "Well done, well done! Bhishma has done a hard thing in fighting Arjuna."

verses.text:
बलवांस्तरुणो दक्षः क्षिप्रकारी च पाण्डवः ।
कोऽन्यः समर्थः पार्थस्य वेगं धारयितुं रणे ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava is strong, young, skilled and quick; who else could withstand Partha's force in battle?

verses.text:
ऋते शांतनवाद्भीष्मात्कृष्णाद्वा देवकीसुतात् ।
आचार्यप्रवराद्वापि भारद्वाजान्महाबलात् ॥

meaning.en: None could, except Bhishma son of Shantanu, Krishna son of Devaki, or the great teacher, mighty Bharadvaja's son Drona.

verses.text:
अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य क्रीडतः पुरुषर्षभौ ।
चक्षूंषि सर्वभूतानां मोहयन्तौ महाबलौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two bulls among men, checking weapons with weapons, played at war and bewildered the eyes of all beings.

verses.text:
प्राजापत्यं तथैवैन्द्रमाग्नेयं च सुदारुणम् ।
कौबेरं वारुणं चैव याम्यं वायव्यमेव च ।
प्रयुञ्जानौ महात्मानौ समरे तौ विचेरतुः ॥

meaning.en: Those two great-souled men ranged the field using the weapons of Prajapati, of Indra, the dreadful fire weapon, and those of Kubera, Varuna, Yama and Vayu.

verses.text:
विस्मितान्यथ भूतानि तौ दृष्ट्वा संयुगे तदा ।
साधु पार्थ महाबाहो साधु भीष्मेति चाब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Beings seeing them in battle were amazed and cried, "Well done, mighty-armed Partha! Well done, Bhishma!"

verses.text:
नेदं युक्तं मनुष्येषु योऽयं संदृश्यते महान् ।
महास्त्राणां संप्रयोगः समरे भीष्मपार्थयोः ॥

meaning.en: "This great use of mighty weapons by Bhishma and Partha, which we see here, is not fitting among mortals."

verses.text:
एवं सर्वास्त्रविदुषोरस्त्रयुद्धमवर्तत ।
अथ जिष्णुरुपावृत्य पृथुधारेण कार्मुकम् ।
चकर्त भीष्मस्य तदा जातरूपपरिष्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: So the weapon-duel went on between the two masters of all weapons. Then Jishnu turned and cut Bhishma's gold-adorned bow with a broad-edged arrow.

verses.text:
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण भीष्मोऽन्यत्कार्मुकं रणे ।
समादाय महाबाहुः सज्यं चक्रे महाबलः ।
शरांश्च सुबहून्क्रुद्धो मुमोचाशु धनंजये ॥

meaning.en: In the blink of an eye mighty-armed Bhishma took another bow, strung it, and in anger quickly loosed many arrows at Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
अर्जुनोऽपि शरांश्चित्रान्भीष्माय निशितान्बहून् ।
चिक्षेप सुमहातेजास्तथा भीष्मश्च पाण्डवे ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna of great energy also shot many sharp and varied arrows at Bhishma, and Bhishma did the same at the Pandava.

verses.text:
तयोर्दिव्यास्त्रविदुषोरस्यतोरनिशं शरान् ।
न विशेषस्तदा राजँल्लक्ष्यते स्म महात्मनोः ॥

meaning.en: As those two masters of divine weapons shot arrows without pause, O king, no difference between the two great men could be seen.

verses.text:
अथावृणोद्दश दिशः शरैरतिरथस्तदा ।
किरीटमाली कौन्तेयः शूरः शांतनवस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then the great chariot-warrior Kiritin, Kunti's son, and the hero son of Shantanu covered all ten directions with arrows.

verses.text:
अतीव पाण्डवो भीष्मं भीष्मश्चातीव पाण्डवम् ।
बभूव तस्मिन्संग्रामे राजँल्लोके तदद्भुतम् ॥

meaning.en: In that battle, O king, the Pandava pressed Bhishma greatly and Bhishma pressed the Pandava greatly, and the world found it a wonder.

verses.text:
पाण्डवेन हताः शूरा भीष्मस्य रथरक्षिणः ।
शेरते स्म तदा राजन्कौन्तेयस्याभितो रथम् ॥

meaning.en: The heroes guarding Bhishma's chariot, slain by the Pandava, lay all around Kunti's son's chariot, O king.

verses.text:
ततो गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्ता निरमित्रं चिकीर्षवः ।
आगच्छन्पुङ्खसंश्लिष्टाः श्वेतवाहनपत्रिणः ॥

meaning.en: Then the arrows loosed from the Gandiva, eager to leave no enemy alive, flew with their feathered ends, the white-horsed Arjuna's shafts.

verses.text:
निष्पतन्तो रथात्तस्य धौता हैरण्यवाससः ।
आकाशे समदृश्यन्त हंसानामिव पङ्क्तयः ॥

meaning.en: Bright and gold-clad, they streamed from his chariot and appeared in the sky like rows of swans.

verses.text:
तस्य तद्दिव्यमस्त्रं हि प्रगाढं चित्रमस्यतः ।
प्रेक्षन्ते स्मान्तरिक्षस्थाः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ॥

meaning.en: All the gods with Indra, standing in the sky, watched his wondrous divine weapon being loosed with such force.

verses.text:
तद्दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतो गन्धर्वश्चित्रमद्भुतम् ।
शशंस देवराजाय चित्रसेनः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing it, the glorious Gandharva Chitrasena, greatly pleased, described the marvel to the king of the gods.

verses.text:
पश्येमानरिनिर्दारान्संसक्तानिव गच्छतः ।
चित्ररूपमिदं जिष्णोर्दिव्यमस्त्रमुदीर्यतः ॥

meaning.en: "Look at these arrows, rending foes, flying as though joined to one another, as Jishnu sends out this wondrous divine weapon."

verses.text:
नेदं मनुष्याः श्रद्दध्युर्न हीदं तेषु विद्यते ।
पौराणानां महास्त्राणां विचित्रोऽयं समागमः ॥

meaning.en: "Men would not believe this, and it does not exist among them: this is a marvellous meeting of the great ancient weapons."

verses.text:
मध्यंदिनगतं सूर्यं प्रतपन्तमिवाम्बरे ।
न शक्नुवन्ति सैन्यानि पाण्डवं प्रतिवीक्षितुम् ॥

meaning.en: The armies cannot even look at the Pandava, who blazes like the midday sun in the sky.

verses.text:
उभौ विश्रुतकर्माणावुभौ युद्धविशारदौ ।
उभौ सदृशकर्माणावुभौ युधि दुरासदौ ॥

meaning.en: Both are famed for their deeds, both skilled in war, both alike in action, both hard to approach in battle.

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो देवराजस्तु पार्थभीष्मसमागमम् ।
पूजयामास दिव्येन पुष्पवर्षेण भारत ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, the king of the gods honored the clash of Partha and Bhishma with a shower of divine flowers, O Bharata.

verses.text:
ततो भीष्मः शांतनवो वामे पार्श्वे समर्पयत् ।
अस्यतः प्रतिसंधाय विवृतं सव्यसाचिनः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhishma, son of Shantanu, aimed at the left side of Savyasachin as he drew, finding the opening.

verses.text:
ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुः पृथुधारेण कार्मुकम् ।
न्यकृन्तद्गार्ध्रपत्रेण भीष्मस्यामिततेजसः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bibhatsu laughed and cut the bow of immeasurably mighty Bhishma with a broad-edged vulture-feathered arrow.

verses.text:
अथैनं दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ।
यतमानं पराक्रान्तं कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Then Dhananjaya, son of Kunti, struck the striving, valiant Bhishma between the breasts with ten arrows.

verses.text:
स पीडितो महाबाहुर्गृहीत्वा रथकूबरम् ।
गाङ्गेयो युधि दुर्धर्षस्तस्थौ दीर्घमिवातुरः ॥

meaning.en: Grievously hurt, mighty-armed Bhishma, hard to overcome in battle, clutched the chariot's pole and stood long as though stricken.

verses.text:
तं विसंज्ञमपोवाह संयन्ता रथवाजिनाम् ।
उपदेशमनुस्मृत्य रक्षमाणो महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: His charioteer, remembering the instruction to protect a great warrior who has lost his senses, carried the unconscious Bhishma away.
